detail.name: Nangong Yu's Namecard
detail.desc: Get by unlocking Nangong Yu's Mindscape: Chips on the Scales
detail.desc2:
A card with the Angels of Delusion's captain, Nangong Yu printed on it.
It features a classic black background with gold foil stamping and faint wing patterns embossed along the edges. When you call, you'll hear the sweet voice of a staff member handling the Angels of Delusion's business inquiries. But rumor has it there's a tiny chance the Angels' captain herself might pick up...
